what: The header that floated transparently over the Hero photo with white text and a centered wordmark becomes a background-color panel with ink text once it passes 200px before the hero’s bottom edge (100px on phones) — the wordmark folds to .4 horizontally (.2s easeOutQuart) and switches off at .1s, and the small icon in its place pops out, overshooting from .7× to 1.2× then settling (.2s cubic-bezier(.59,1.72,.52,.88)). Scrolling back up, the icon hides to .7× in .3s and the wordmark stands again. Below 1024px there is no wordmark, only the icon

options.target: Hero whose bottom edge is the reference (selector). If none, 0 — switches after only a small scroll
options.offset: Panel kicks in this many px before the hero’s bottom edge, default 200
options.offset-sm: Offset below the bp width, default 100
options.bp: Width (px) at which offset-sm applies, default 1024
options.state: solid: Expanding panel · icon (subpage that starts without a photo)
options.[data-fx-part=wordmark] · [data-fx-part=: Wordmark and icon (children) layered in one cell — the cell’s position and size are up to the parent
options.[data-solid]: Attribute attached once it becomes a panel — the consuming css selects inner buttons·lines with it
options.--fx-ink · --fx-ink-solid · --fx-bg-soli: Text color when transparent (default --kf-on-accent) · text color when filled (--kf-ink) · fill color (--kf-bg)
options.--fx-pop · --fx-pop-ease · --fx-icon-sca: Icon pop-out length, curve and size (via style), default .2s · cubic-bezier(.59,1.72,.52,.88) · 1.2
options.--fx-fold · --fx-hide · --fx-out · --fx-: Wordmark collapses .2s · icon hides .3s · off .1s · collapse curve cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1)

from.where: shared.css .ib-head — original Header logoFull · logoIcon (--header-scroll-offset 200 · 100, html[data-path=/] only for the wordmark)
